license_required.quote: No person, unless exempted under this chapter, may offer, attempt or agree to perform, or perform any act enumerated within this chapter without an active license issued by the commission.

issuing_authority.quote: "Commission," the South Dakota Real Estate Commission

name.quote: There is created a South Dakota Real Estate Commission.

type.quote: There is created a South Dakota Real Estate Commission. The commission consists of five members appointed by the Governor.

age_minimum.quote: A license shall be granted only to persons of reputable character who have attained the age of eighteen years

moral_character_required.quote: A license shall be granted only to persons of reputable character who have attained the age of eighteen years; who are competent to transact the business of a licensee in a manner as to safeguard the interest of the public

degree_required.value: 116 class hours of education in a course of study approved by the commission (broker associate); 24 additional class hours beyond broker associate level plus 2 years active service for responsible broker
degree_required.quote: An applicant for a broker associate license must have completed one hundred sixteen class hours of education in a course of study approved by the commission

degree_level.quote: An applicant for a broker associate license must have completed one hundred sixteen class hours of education in a course of study approved by the commission given by instructors approved by the commission or in an independent study or distance education course approved by the commission.

school_approval_basis.quote: a course of study approved by the commission given by instructors approved by the commission or in an independent study or distance education course approved by the commission

credential_pegged.quote: An applicant for a broker associate license must have completed one hundred sixteen class hours of education in a course of study approved by the commission

tiers.quote: An applicant for a broker associate license must have completed one hundred sixteen class hours of education in a course of study approved by the commission

An applicant for a responsible broker's license shall have served actively for two years as a licensed salesperson or broker associate, or a combination thereof, and shall furnish evidence of completion of twenty-four additional class hours beyond the broker associate level

required.quote: An applicant for a responsible broker's license shall have served actively for two years as a licensed salesperson or broker associate, or a combination thereof

experience_source.quote: An applicant for a responsible broker's license shall have served actively for two years as a licensed salesperson or broker associate, or a combination thereof

duration.quote: shall have served actively for two years as a licensed salesperson or broker associate, or a combination thereof

kind.quote: served actively for two years as a licensed salesperson or broker associate, or a combination thereof

exams.name: Real estate licensing examination
exams.notes: Written examination conducted by the commission at times and places it directs; contents determined by the commission. Out-of-state applicants with active license who passed that state's exam need only pass the state portion.
exams.quote: An applicant for a license shall submit to a written examination to be conducted by the commission at such times and places as it may direct.

interval_years.quote: A licensee, either active or inactive, shall register every two years with the commission

required.quote: An individual licensee shall provide to the commission proof of participation in the following required number of hours of approved continuing education in the preceding two-year period

hours_per_period.quote: Responsible broker, broker associate, salesperson, auctioneer, or property manager: not less than twenty-four hours

period_years.quote: proof of participation in the following required number of hours of approved continuing education in the preceding two-year period

available.quote: The commission shall recognize the license issued by another state as qualification for a license in South Dakota.

requirements.value: An applicant who holds an active license in another state and passed that state's real estate licensing exam may obtain a similar level of licensure in SD by passing the state portion of the SD exam. For states not granting full reciprocity to SD licensees, the applicant must meet the same requirements that state requires of SD licensees.
requirements.quote: An applicant who holds an active license in another state and who has successfully passed the real estate licensing examination in that same state may obtain a similar level of licensure in South Dakota if the applicant successfully passes the state portion of the examination in South Dakota.

exists.quote: There is created a South Dakota Real Estate Commission. The commission consists of five members appointed by the Governor. The members may not all be of the same political party. Three members shall be active real estate brokers; two shall be members of the public.

regulatory_model.quote: No person, unless exempted under this chapter, may offer, attempt or agree to perform, or perform any act enumerated within this chapter without an active license issued by the commission.

credential_type.quote: No person, unless exempted under this chapter, may offer, attempt or agree to perform, or perform any act enumerated within this chapter without an active license issued by the commission.

is_mandatory.quote: No person, unless exempted under this chapter, may offer, attempt or agree to perform, or perform any act enumerated within this chapter without an active license issued by the commission.

title_protection.quote: Selling, buying, exchanging or leasing real property in a manner indicating that the licensee is not licensed under this chapter

scope_protection.quote: No person, unless exempted under this chapter, may offer, attempt or agree to perform, or perform any act enumerated within this chapter without an active license issued by the commission.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provisions of the chapter or rules promulgated by the commission
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provisions of this chapter or any rule promulgated by the commission

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a material false statement in the license application or information furnished to the commission
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a material false statement in the licensee's application for a license or in any information furnished to the commission

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making substantial and willful misrepresentation in a transaction injurious to any party
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any substantial and willful misrepresentation with reference to a transaction which is injurious to any party

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a false promise or advertisement to influence a party to a transaction to their injury
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any false promise or advertisement of a character such as to influence, persuade or induce a party to a transaction to the party's injury or damage

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to account for or remit money belonging to others, commingling funds, or failing to maintain escrow/trust account
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to account for or to remit, within a reasonable time, any moneys coming into the licensee's possession belonging to others, commingling funds of others with the licensee's own, failing to keep the funds of others in an escrow or trust account

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of or pleading guilty or nolo contendere to a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude or a felony
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted, or pleading guilty or nolo contendere before a court of competent jurisdiction in this or any other state, or before any federal court, of a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude or a felony

disciplinary_grounds.description: Claiming or taking secret or undisclosed compensation or failing to reveal full compensation to principal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Claiming or taking any secret or undisclosed amount of compensation or the failure of a licensee to reveal to the licensee's principal or employer the full amount of compensation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing or refusing to produce documents, books, or records concerning a transaction under investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing or refusing upon demand to produce any document, book, or record in the licensee's possession or under the licensee's control, concerning a transaction under investigation by the commission

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering real property for sale or lease without prior written consent of the owner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Offering real property for sale or lease without the knowledge and prior written consent of the owner or the owner's authorized agent

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of federal or state fair housing requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any violation of federal or state fair housing requirements

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing or refusing to furnish copies of documents to a person whose signature is on the document
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing or refusing upon demand to furnish copies including reproductions of any document pertaining to any transaction dealing with real estate to a person whose signature is affixed thereto

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying compensation or commission to an unlicensed person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Paying compensation or commission in connection with a transaction to any person who is not licensed under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to disclose in writing to owner the licensee's intention to purchase property listed with the licensee's office
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to disclose to an owner in writing the licensee's intention or true position if the licensee directly or indirectly through a third party purchases for himself or herself or acquires or intends to acquire any interest in or any option to purchase property which has been listed with the licensee's office

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure by a broker to deliver complete, dated, and signed closing statements to seller and buyer
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure by a broker to deliver to the seller in every real estate transaction, at the time the transaction is consummated, a complete, detailed closing statement

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any conduct constituting dishonesty or fraudulent conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any other conduct which constitutes dishonesty or fraudulent conduct, whether arising within or without the pursuit of the licensee's license privilege

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting employment for appraising contingent on reporting a predetermined value or appraising property with undisclosed interest
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepting employment or compensation for appraising real estate contingent upon reporting a predetermined value or issuing an appraisal report on real estate in which the licensee has an undisclosed interest

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation or suspension of any other license held by the licensee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The revocation or suspension of any other license held by a person licensed under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using two or more contracts to enable purchaser to obtain a larger loan or qualify for a loan the purchaser otherwise could not
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using, proposing the use, agreeing to the use or knowingly permitting the use of two or more contracts of sale, earnest money agreements or loan applications, one of which is not made known to the prospective lender or the loan guarantor

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to promptly give a copy of an offer to purchase to the purchaser
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to promptly give a copy of an offer to purchase to the purchaser

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to promptly give the seller every written offer to purchase obtained
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to promptly give the seller every written offer to purchase obtained

disciplinary_grounds.description: Upon obtaining acceptance signed by seller, failing to promptly give copies to both purchaser and seller
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Upon obtaining an acceptance of the offer signed by the seller, failing to promptly give a copy of it to both purchaser and seller

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to make certain all terms and conditions are included in the offer to purchase
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to make certain that all of the terms and conditions of the transaction are included in the offer to purchase

disciplinary_grounds.description: Giving a title opinion upon merchantability of title in a transaction in which the licensee participated
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Giving a title opinion upon the merchantability of the title to property in any transaction in which the licensee participated

disciplinary_grounds.description: Preparing legal documents, giving legal advice, or engaging in the practice of law (with limited exemptions)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Preparing any legal document, giving any legal advice, or otherwise engaging in the practice of law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting use of broker's license to enable salespersons to operate a brokerage business with only insignificant broker control
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting the use of a broker's license to enable licensed salespersons to establish and carry on a real estate brokerage business if the broker has only insignificant control of the affairs of the business conducted

disciplinary_grounds.description: Taking a net listing whereby the licensee takes as compensation proceeds over the agreed selling price
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Taking a net listing whereby a licensee agrees to take as compensation the proceeds of a sale over and above the selling price agreed in the listing contract

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to put in writing all guarantees of sale made to the person listing property
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to put in writing all guarantees of sale and other guarantees made by a licensee to the person listing the property for sale

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to put in writing any agreement to furnish or sell a warranty
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to put in writing any agreement to furnish or sell a warranty

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to solicit listings without first advising the owner that the licensee is a licensed real estate broker
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempting to solicit or attempting to secure listings without first advising the owner that the licensee is a licensee and is engaged in real estate brokerage

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to protect and promote the interests of the client to the best of the licensee's ability
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to protect and promote the interests of the client whom the licensee has undertaken to represent to the best of the licensee's ability

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to deal fairly with all parties to a transaction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to deal fairly with all parties to a transaction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing any act constituting bad faith, incompetency, or fraudulent dealings
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing any act constituting or demonstrating bad faith, incompetency or fraudulent dealings

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using licensee's position to gain undue influence, coerce, or use duress on a buyer, seller, landlord, or tenant
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using the licensee's position to gain undue influence over a prospective buyer, seller, landlord, or tenant, using the licensee's position to coerce a buyer, seller, landlord, or tenant, or using duress on a buyer, seller, landlord, or tenant

disciplinary_grounds.description: Issuing an insufficient funds check
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Issuing an insufficient funds check

disciplinary_grounds.description: Associating in a business requiring commission licensing with a person whose license is suspended or revoked
disciplinary_grounds.quote: In a business enterprise that requires licensing by the commission, associating in any manner with another person who has had a license suspended or revoked by action of the commission while the suspension or revocation is in effect.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Buying/selling/leasing under a partnership or corporation with licensee ownership interest while indicating the transaction is by a private unlicensed party
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Buying, selling, leasing, or exchanging real property under the auspices of a partnership or corporation of which the licensee owns an interest if it is indicated that the purchase or sale is being made by a private party not licensed by the real estate commission

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a contract allowing the licensee to purchase or lease listed property and charge commission without written consent of principal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a listing contract or any other contract with the licensee's principal which allows the licensee to purchase or lease the listed property and charge a commission thereon without obtaining the written consent of the principal

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting a non-negotiable instrument as earnest money without written permission of the principal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepting a note or other nonnegotiable instrument or anything of value not readily negotiable as earnest money on a contract or offer to purchase without the written permission of the licensee's principal

disciplinary_grounds.description: Selling, buying, exchanging, or leasing real property in a manner indicating the licensee is not licensed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Selling, buying, exchanging or leasing real property in a manner indicating that the licensee is not licensed under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Improperly influencing or attempting to influence the development, reporting, result, or review of a real estate appraisal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Improperly influencing or attempting to influence the development, reporting, result, or review of a real estate appraisal by coercion, extortion, or bribery

insurance_required.quote: The real estate commission shall adopt rules, pursuant to chapter 1-26, requiring as a condition of licensure that all real estate salesman and brokers, except those who hold inactive licenses, carry errors and omissions insurance covering all activities contemplated under this chapter.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: No partnership, association, limited liability company, or corporation may perform the services of a real estate broker as described in §36-21A-6, nor may a licensee associate or work for any partnership, association, limited liability company, or corporation performing any services described in §36-21A-6, until such time as the partnership, association, limited liability company, or corporation is licensed by the commission.

definition_quote.value: For the purposes of this chapter, a broker or a real estate broker is any person who does any of the following: (1) For another and for compensation or consideration or with the intention or expectation of receiving compensation or consideration, directly or indirectly, lists, sells, exchanges, buys, rents, manages, offers or attempts to negotiate a sale, option, exchange, purchase, lease or rental of an interest in real property...
definition_quote.quote: a broker or a real estate broker is any person who does any of the following: (1)For another and for compensation or consideration or with the intention or expectation of receiving compensation or consideration, directly or indirectly, lists, sells, exchanges, buys, rents, manages, offers or attempts to negotiate a sale, option, exchange, purchase, lease or rental of an interest in real property

license_tiers.quote: "Broker associate," any broker acting in association with or under the auspices of a responsible broker

broker_of_record_required.quote: No license may be granted to a corporation, limited liability company, partnership or association, unless the corporation, limited liability company, partnership, or association designates a responsible broker who will represent the corporation, limited liability company, partnership, or association.

pre_exam_experience_years.quote: An applicant for a responsible broker's license shall have served actively for two years as a licensed salesperson or broker associate, or a combination thereof

pre_exam_instruction_hours.quote: An applicant for a broker associate license must have completed one hundred sixteen class hours of education in a course of study approved by the commission

license_revocation_reapplication_waiting.quote: whose license has not been revoked in this or any other state within five years prior to date of application

agency_relationship_types.quote: Any licensee performing services authorized by §§36-21A-119 to 36-21A-150, inclusive, is limited to the following relationships: (1)Single agent: (a)Seller/landlord agent; (b)Buyer/tenant agent; (2)Limited agent; (3)Subagent; and (4)Transaction broker.

dual_agency_written_consent_required.quote: A licensee may act as a limited agent only with the informed written consent of all parties to the transaction.

designated_agency_permitted.quote: A real estate brokerage entering into an agency agreement may, through the responsible broker, appoint to the client those licensees affiliated with the brokerage who will act as appointed agents of that client to the exclusion of all other licensees affiliated with the brokerage.

transaction_licensee_role_permitted.quote: "Transaction broker," a broker who assists one or more parties with a real estate transaction without being an agent or advocate for the interests of any party to the transaction.

initial_interview_disclosure_required.quote: At the first substantive contact with a seller or buyer who has not entered into a written agreement with a broker, the licensee shall: (1)Disclose in writing to that person the types of agency and brokerage relationships the broker is offering to that person; and (2)Provide that person with a written copy of a disclosure on a form prescribed by the commission.

written_service_agreement_required.quote: Any agency agreement in which a broker represents a seller or lessor shall be in writing

value: authorization to cooperate with or compensate other brokers
sales_contract_mandatory_disclosures.quote: Any agency agreement in which a broker represents a seller or lessor shall be in writing and shall contain the proper legal description, the price and terms, the date of authorization, the expiration date, the type of agency relationship established, compensation to be paid, authorization to cooperate with or compensate other brokers, and the signatures of all parties.

listing_contract_termination_date_requir.quote: Any agency agreement in which a broker represents a seller or lessor shall be in writing and shall contain the proper legal description, the price and terms, the date of authorization, the expiration date

transaction_record_retention_years.quote: A licensee shall preserve for four years all listings, offers to purchase, closing statements and other records relating to any real estate transaction.

escrow_account_required.quote: the responsible broker shall deposit the money in a federally insured financial institution in a special trust account on the first legal banking day after the acceptance of the contract.

escrow_deposit_deadline_business_days.quote: the responsible broker shall deposit the money in a federally insured financial institution in a special trust account on the first legal banking day after the acceptance of the contract.

commingling_of_funds_prohibited.quote: commingling funds of others with the licensee's own, failing to keep the funds of others in an escrow or trust account with a federally insured financial institution

salesperson_broker_affiliation_required.quote: A salesperson or broker associate who is not associated with a responsible broker may renew the license by submitting the renewal fee, together with the completed renewal application on which the licensee has noted inactive status. An inactive salesperson or broker associate whose license has been renewed may not engage in the real estate business until the licensee secures a new responsible broker.

recovery_fund_exists.quote: The commission shall establish and maintain a real estate recovery fund, which shall be used to provide a source for payment of unsatisfied judgments obtained by persons aggrieved by the acts of a person licensed under this chapter.

promotional_land_sales_registration_requ.quote: Before subdivided land is offered for sale the subdivider shall apply in writing for a subdivision certificate to the commission

broker_price_opinion_permitted.quote: For another and for compensation or consideration or with the intention or expectation of receiving compensation or consideration, directly or indirectly, prepares or offers to prepare a broker price opinion or a comparative market analysis

comparative_market_analysis_permitted.quote: the terms, broker price opinion and comparative market analysis, mean an estimate prepared by a licensed broker or salesperson that details the probable selling price or leasing price of a particular parcel of or interest in real property
